🔥 अरे भाई! बॉलीवुड के सुरों के बादशाह सोनू निगम ने कर दिया एक और बड़ा प्रॉपर्टी का सौदा! 💰

सquare Yards द्वारा देखे गए दस्तावेजों के मुताबिक, सिंगर ने मुंबई के Santacruz West इलाके में 31.47 करोड़ रुपये में एक कमर्शियल प्रॉपर्टी खरीदी है। 🏢

नवंबर 2026 में रजिस्टर्ड यह डील इस साल उनके कई रियल एस्टेट निवेशों में से एक है। 📈

report के मुताबिक, उन्होंने नवंबर में Andheri West में 44.3 करोड़ का अपार्टमेंट और अक्टूबर में लगभग 17 करोड़ में तीन कमर्शियल यूनिट्स भी खरीदे थे। 📝

इसके अलावा अगस्त में Lokhandwala Road पर 1 करोड़ की ऑफिस स्पेस और दिसंबर 2025 में BKC में एक कमर्शियल यूनिट लीज पर दी थी। 🤝

तो दोस्तों, क्या लगता है सोनू निगम का यह नया प्रॉपर्टी दांव कैसा रहेगा? नीचे कमेंट्स में जरूर बताओ! 🎤

ctx.title: Sonu Nigam buys property in Mumbai’s Santacruz West for Rs 31.47 crore
ctx.text:
Playback singer Sonu Nigam has acquired a commercial property in Mumbai’s Santacruz West locality for Rs 31.47 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards on the website of the Inspector General of Registration, Maharashtra. The deal was officially registered in November 2026.
The purchase is the latest in a series of real estate investments that Nigam has made across Mumbai this year. In November, he purchased a luxury residential apartment in Andheri West for Rs 44.3 crore. In October, the singer acquired three commercial units in a building called Aston in Andheri West for approximately Rs 17 crore, including a ground-floor office bought for Rs 1 crore in a separate transaction registered the same day.
In August, Sonu Nugam picked up a 258 square-foot office space in the Sundervan Complex on Lokhandwala Road in Andheri West for Rs 1 crore. And in December 2025, he leased a 4,257 square-foot commercial unit at Trade Centre in BKC, Santacruz East, to Pattni Hospitality, the operators of the cafe-bar chain Downtown 29, in a five-year deal valued at over Rs 12.61 crore.
Also Read: Sonu Nigam’s Bengaluru concert sparks row: Pro-Kannada group seeks ban over past remarks
Sonu Nigam’s career began as a child performer. He first appeared on stage at the age of four and went on to participate in singing competitions throughout his teens before making his playback debut in the early 1990s. His breakthrough came in the late 1990s and early 2000s, a period during which he established himself alongside Kumar Sanu, Udit Narayan and later Arijit Singh as one of the defining male voices of Hindi cinema.
Also Read: Sonu Nigam says T-Series, Zee Music banned him over copyright fight: ‘He’s become an activist’
Beyond Hindi, Nigam has sung in multiple Indian languages including Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali. He has also released independent music and has been vocal about issues within the music industry, including the dominance of music labels and the challenges independent artistes face in getting fair compensation.
